title: asap 1.0.0: MIT, declared in the old package.json "licenses" array

components.name: asap
components.evidence: package.json has no "license" field, only "licenses": [{"type": "MIT", "url": "https://github.com/kriskowal/asap/raw/master/LICENSE.md"}] (so Vite's build.license prints no identifier). The package's LICENSE.md is the MIT text with the line above; the npm tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/asap/-/asap-1.0.0.tgz (sha512 = lockfile integrity) holds the same bytes as package/LICENSE.md. kriskowal/asap has no v1 tag (its tags start at v2.0.0) and the registry has no gitHead, so the tarball is the primary source. Shipped module: asap.js.
